items.translation: 如果请求符合未修改的条件，则返回相应的响应；否则返回空结果。

items.source: Note: you can use either this #checkNotModified(Instant) method; or checkNotModified(String). If you want to enforce both a strong entity tag and a Last-Modified value, as recommended by the HTTP specification, then you should use checkNotModified(Instant, String).
items.translation: 注意： 您可以使用此#checkNotModified(Instant)方法；或checkNotModified(String)。如果您希望同时强制执行强实体标签和 Last-Modified 值（如 HTTP 规范所推荐），则应使用checkNotModified(Instant, String)。

items.source: Note: calling this method causes the request body to be read and parsed in full, and the resulting MultiValueMap is cached so that this method is safe to call more than once.

items.source:
Always guaranteed to return an instance either matching the session id
requested by the client, or with a new session id either because the client
did not specify one or because the underlying session had expired.
items.translation: 始终保证返回一个实例，该实例要么匹配客户端请求的会话 ID，要么具有新的会话 ID（因为客户端未指定会话 ID 或底层会话已过期）。

items.source: Use of this method does not automatically create a session.
items.translation: 使用此方法不会自动创建会话。
